name.value: Fort Rodd Hill and Fisgard Lighthouse National Historic Sites

description.value: Fort Rodd Hill and Fisgard Lighthouse National Historic Sites encompass a 19th-century coastal artillery fortress that guarded Esquimalt Harbour from 1895 to 1956, alongside Fisgard Lighthouse — the oldest permanent lighthouse on Canada's west coast — connected to the fort by a built causeway. The site occupies a dramatic coastal headland near Victoria, surrounded by rare Garry Oak ecosystems and sweeping ocean views. Cyclists exploring the area can tour the grounds and historic buildings via a free self-guided app, and oTENTik glamping accommodations are available inside the working fort for those seeking an overnight coastal experience.
